cycle_index_definition: M,G,D,q,q2,s are values settled after edge n. At edge n+1, captures read old M(n); accepted CE(n+1) updates M(n+1) with nonblocking assignment. q/s describe prior accepted read; q2 masks captured data. rst_n=false clears q/q2/s only.

model_proposal.claim_boundary: A formal-source/model proposal only. No engine/capture RTL change, synthesis, P&R or rate adoption. Direct bit capture still requires current macro arcs, pin loads/wires/skew and contextual SS/FF; old7.895628ps ideal margin is not transferred.

local_select_sizing_scenario.explanation: Ordinary local select registers/buffers need explicit preservation, loads and physical placement. No blind route or fanout/depth sweep is admitted.

source_capture_contract.added_cycle_policy: No retiming implemented. Any added stage must price actual issued-program waits in +55 successor before RTL/P&R; preserve existing MEM_EXTRA once.
source_capture_contract.claim_boundary: Exact existing cone inventory and port/control replication model; register area is a lower bound. No replacement RTL, clock relaxation, token-rate change or current routed closure.

model_review_required: Review direct macro-to-DFF pin/load path under SS833.333/60 and FF25 with actual wires and relative clock insertion; no transfer of ideal7.895628ps margin.
Capture-data feedback removal does not remove bank masks/OR or selector feedback; model both complete control and output cones.
The fixed local-select sizing scenario explicitly adds75 clock/reset FF pins and21.87um2 register-only lower-bound area; buffer cells, nets, reset, CTS, track demand and slot fit remain unknown.

No additional stage is proposed. Confirm unchanged waits in full same-program +55 MLAT/TREE/MUL price. If model requires retiming, reject this zero-cycle proposal and create a separately priced successor.
Require mapped replicas to survive synthesis and bound actual capture/output/control paths before any tile P&R. No fanout/depth architecture sweep.
observability: Only q2-selected bank output and source consumers after unchanged MEM_EXTRA/tag delay. Neither equality of unselected bank captures nor their initialization is claimed.
proposed_event_invariant: q2[b] and not(s and q[b]) implies G[p,b]=low256(M[p,b]).

same_program_55_bridge_reference.claim_boundary: Analytical same-program body replay plus separate KV_PREP; collective, service, macro-local fill and clock-domain composition are not new measurements. No rate, die-count selection or hardware adoption. Existing historical pricing remains unchanged.

assumptions: Known Boolean clock/reset/read and address when read; nonblocking pre-edge data semantics.
Actual ROM rd_out holds while ce_in=0, with exactly this wrapper as its owner.
No change to source selector, delayed mask, reset semantics, accepted read/tag timing or macro geometry.
Arbitrary independent initial macro/capture bits and arbitrary full266-bit accepted read words; no unselected value is qualified.
source_event_comparison.consumer_relation: Existing wrom_q bank mask and MEM_EXTRA1 tag delays unchanged; mq_wrom samples the prior-edge output, so post-edge output equality implies identical subsequent sampled data.
source_event_comparison.four_state_scope: Bitvector proof quantifies every binary assignment to uninitialized/data bits; no X/0 initialization is assumed. A literal four-state RTL cone gate remains required after model review. Unselected cap equality is explicitly not claimed.
source_event_comparison.proposed_transition_only: For each p=0..1,b=0..4, U_next[p,b] = M[p,b][255:0] every clock edge. No RTL emitted.
source_event_comparison.reset_scope: Reset may assert asynchronously between edges: q,q2,s clear and output masks zero. M,G,U have no reset and remain arbitrary. At a clock edge under reset the macro may still read; q2 stayszero. First accepted read after release is covered by induction.
